attchmntText: Jullundur Motor Agency (Delhi) Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Buyback  is 18-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: Jullundur Motor Agency Delhi Limited approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The board also approved a proposed buyback of up to 20,00,000 equity shares at Rs. 112 per share, totaling Rs. 22,40,00,000. This buyback is subject to shareholder approval and follows the Board approval route under Section 68(2)(b) of the Companies Act, 2013. The record date for eligibility is November 18, 2026. Promoters intend not to participate. Corporate Professionals Capital Private Limited is appointed as the merchant banker. The company fixed the record date for ascertaining shareholder eligibility. Financial results show a net profit after tax of Rs. 672.03 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026.
